title: Modules
text:
This course covers the path from raw wrist-worn accelerometry to reproducible analysis: device and study design, reading and processing raw signals, activity metrics, analysis and summaries, and quality control. Throughout, it distinguishes observed data from inserted, filtered, resampled, or inferred values.





Module
Main question
Teaching dataset




1. Accelerometer Devices and Studies
What do accelerometers measure, and how are wearable studies designed?
Raw device data and study examples


2. Reading and Processing Data
How do we read, inspect, calibrate, and process raw acceleration?
Raw time/x/y/z data


3. Activity Metrics
How do ENMO, MAD, MIMS, counts, and steps summarize movement?
Raw acceleration segment


4. Analysis and Summaries
How do we visualize, summarize, and model minute-level activity?
NHANES minute-level data


99. Reproducibility, QC, and Other Methods
How do we audit the pipeline and extend it to specialized methods?
Full example project
